decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core pipeline business that fits existing capabilities and customer needs in a growing industry, it is likely to meet or stay near aspiration levels and is therefore worth keeping.

As an unrelated diversification into public waste bins, it likely faces weaker fit with the firm's main aspirations and, if results are only modest, management would reallocate resources back to the stronger core business.

Although it can use metalworking and coating skills, this waste bin with ashtray remains peripheral to the firm's established offer, so a likely shortfall versus aspirations would push management to discontinue it.

Outdoor public ashtrays are the most peripheral to the firm's infrastructure-focused range, so under behavioral decision-making they are the most likely to be abandoned in favor of core products or more promising developments.
